input.overview: Shoot the Rocket ramp until its LED reaches 1, then shoot it again to start Multiball. Selectable Missions begin at the plunge or lit right saucer, while briefly lit orbits advance the spacecraft toward Splashdown; nine completed Missions qualify Master Alarm.
input.simpleOverview: Shoot the Rocket ramp until its LED reaches 1, then shoot it once more for Multiball. Choose Start Mission at the plunge or shoot the lit right saucer for a Mission, and use briefly lit orbits to advance the spacecraft separately.
input.summary: Use the plunge to start a Mission, then repeat the Rocket ramp until its LED reads 1 and shoot the Rocket again for Multiball. Take lit orbits after their matching inlane feeds when control allows, because those advances build the separate route toward Splashdown.

quickInfo.name: Missions
quickInfo.summary: Choose Start Mission on the plunge or shoot the right saucer while its red lamp is lit. Nine played Missions qualify Master Alarm at that saucer.

quickInfo.name: Regular Multiball
quickInfo.summary: The first start needs three Rocket-ramp shots; later starts add two shots. The Rocket LED shows the remaining count.

quickInfo.name: 13-Ball
quickInfo.summary: Complete B-L-A-S-T-O-F-F with lit ramp shots, exact ramp combos, or Mystery. The next qualified Rocket Multiball becomes 13-Ball.

quickInfo.name: Spacecraft
quickInfo.summary: An inlane briefly lights the opposite orbit. Shoot lit orbits to advance through Video Mode, Power Down, Power Up, and Splashdown.

quickInfo.name: Shoot the Moon
quickInfo.summary: Hit M-O-O-N in sequence, then shoot the Blastoff ramp to collect the hurry-up before draining.

steps.text: Choose Start Mission on the plunge, or shoot the right saucer while its red Start Mission lamp is lit. Follow the display for the current Mission’s physical shots.
Repeat the Rocket ramp and watch its LED. The first Multiball takes three Rocket shots; when the LED reads 1, the next Rocket shot starts it.
During regular Multiball, collect the left-orbit, spinner-lane, right-orbit, and right-saucer Jackpots. Shoot the Blastoff ramp for the Super Jackpot after all four are collected.
Complete M-O-O-N in sequence during controlled one-ball play, then shoot the Blastoff ramp for Shoot the Moon. The same target sequence can light the Super during Multiball.
After a left or right inlane, shoot the briefly lit opposite orbit to advance the spacecraft. Keep taking these controlled transfers toward Video Mode, Power Down, Power Up, and Splashdown.
Shoot the Blastoff ramp when its yellow lamp is lit, or make the exact lit ramp combo, to collect B-L-A-S-T-O-F-F. Once the word is complete, build the next Rocket Multiball to start 13-Ball.
Play all nine Missions; after Master Alarm is qualified, spin the left spinner when needed to relight the right saucer.
Shoot the lit right saucer to start Master Alarm, then follow its lit shots and repeatable Blastoff-ramp Jackpot.
Continue collecting lit-orbit spacecraft advances until the final orbit requirement starts Splashdown.

playfieldReferences.label: Rocket Multiball ramp
playfieldReferences.description: The short center-left metal ramp with the remaining-shot LED beneath it.

playfieldReferences.label: Blastoff and Super Jackpot ramp
playfieldReferences.description: The shallow center-right blue ramp used by BLASTOFF, Shoot the Moon, and regular Multiball’s Super Jackpot.

playfieldReferences.label: Mission start saucer
playfieldReferences.description: The short lane and saucer on the right that starts a lit Mission or Master Alarm.

cautions.issue: CPU 5.01 leaves some scoring values uncertain, and other ROM revisions can differ.
cautions.response: Use the physical starts and display prompts; do not assume the same values or timers on every ROM and setup.

cautions.issue: Regular and Novice games use different time and ball structures.
cautions.response: This route assumes the normal Regular selection; Novice is a timed game with drained balls relaunched until time expires.
